description: This file defines the OA_Maintenance_Pruning class, which provides methods for pruning and maintaining the data tables related to ad zone associations in the Revive Adserver project. It includes functions for deleting old or expired records, optimizing table storage, and handling campaign-related data cleanup.

classes.name: OA_Maintenance_Pruning
classes.description: A wrapper class for running maintenance and pruning operations on ad zone association data tables, including old data removal, campaign cleanup, and table overhead logging.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the class by calling the parent constructor.

methods.name: run
methods.description: Executes the main pruning process, currently calling _pruneDataSummaryAdZoneAssoc.

methods.name: _pruneDataSummaryAdZoneAssoc
methods.description: Performs multiple pruning steps on the data_summary_ad_zone_assoc table, including removing old data, expired campaigns, and completed campaigns based on configuration.

methods.name: _pruneDataSummaryAdZoneAssocOldData
methods.description: Prunes old records from the data_summary_ad_zone_assoc table based on a time threshold, using either optimized temp table method or delete.

methods.name: _pruneDataSummaryAdZoneAssocInactiveExpired
methods.description: Removes records for inactive campaigns that have expired, based on campaign status and end date.

methods.name: _pruneDataSummaryAdZoneAssocInactiveTargetReached
methods.description: Removes records for campaigns that have reached their lifetime targets and are inactive.

methods.name: _logTableOverhead
methods.description: Logs the amount of unused space in a specified table and suggests optimization if overhead exists.

methods.name: pruneDSAZAOldDataWithDelete
methods.description: Deletes old data from a table using a simple DELETE statement.

methods.name: pruneDSAZAOldDataWithTempTable
methods.description: Uses a temporary table to prune old data more efficiently, then drops the temporary table.
